stem: After a large increase in potassium, older leaves begin showing a magnesium-like pattern. What should be checked first?
choices: Cation balance, root-zone pH/EC and symptom progression
Whether the lights are the same color
Whether every nutrient can be doubled
rationale: Potassium, calcium and magnesium interact as cations, so balance and root-zone context should be reviewed before simply adding more fertilizer.
